name: InstanceCull
scope: Original compute shader and root signature at Xbox device slot 62. The fixtures check frustum culling, wave allocation, clipped queue writes, optional statistics, multiview candidate records and impostor visibility atomics. HZB permutations additionally check the occluded instance list and next dispatch arguments, including spatially distinct depths and explicit sampling of mip 1. Post-pass checks consume that list and verify three-word candidate records, clipping, counters and impostors. Each check compares every output word.
